analysis: Aprepitant, Dexamethasone, and Ondansetron are all used to prevent or treat nausea and vomiting associated with cancer chemotherapy. Aprepitant works as a neurokinin-1 receptor antagonist, Dexamethasone serves as a corticosteroid, and Ondansetron functions as a serotonin 5-HT3 receptor antagonist. Each of these drugs targets different pathways involved in the emetic response, making them effective in managing chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting.
